response.title: which robot mower mows best in wet grass
response.answer:
For mowing wet grass, I'd prioritize a robot mower with strong traction, a cutting system that resists clogging, and the ability to handle damp, heavy grass without leaving clumps.

There's an important distinction:

Wet grass from dew or light rain: Several premium robotic mowers can handle this well.

Soaking-wet or long grass: Most robotic mowers struggle, even if they're waterproof. Wet clippings stick to the blades and mower deck, reducing cut quality.

For consistently wet lawns, I would favor an all-wheel-drive mower with a relatively high cutting deck over a lightweight model designed primarily for dry, frequently maintained lawns.

My top picks for wet grass in 2026
Shop
Best overall for damp grass

Mammotion LUBA 3 AWD

Approx. $2,800–$3,300 depending on model

AWD, deep-tread wheels and dual cutting discs. An independent 2026 review reported excellent results on long, wet grass, with consistently strong cutting quality. It can still scuff soft, saturated turf during turns. 
The Independent
+1

Shop

Husqvarna Automower 420 iQ

Best for routine mowing in rain

Husqvarna explicitly describes its 410 iQ and 420 iQ as designed to operate rain or shine. I'd favor this for frequent maintenance of a relatively level, damp lawn rather than heavy wet overgrowth. 
MowScout

Shop

NAVIMOW i210 AWD 7.1 in. Robot Lawn Mower (1/4 Acre) RTK + V…

$1,099.00 at The Home Depot

Best smaller-lawn alternative. AWD and promising damp-grass traction in hands-on testing, although Segway generally recommends mowing in dry conditions. 
Robovations
+1

My pick: Mammotion LUBA 3 AWD for cutting performance on damp, challenging grass; Husqvarna 420 iQ if you specifically want a mower designed to operate through rainy weather.

I haven't found a controlled, head-to-head wet-grass cutting test of all three, so this is a recommendation based on published hands-on results and manufacturer guidance, not a definitive measured ranking.

Two questions that would change my recommendation
What makes your grass wet?
Morning dew
Frequent rain
Soggy or saturated ground
What is your lawn like?
Short, regularly maintained grass
Thick or tall grass
Sloped or hilly lawn
Refine recommendation
